packageRules.description: Pin ByteBuddy to avoid Jacoco transform conflicts

Hold AGP on 9.3.x: from 9.4.0 connectedAndroidTest runs the new android-test-engine inside a Gradle worker daemon whose environment is only HOME and LANG, so the ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT that sair-acquire exports never reaches the adb subprocesses and every on-device run fails. Revisit when AGP forwards the ADB server port to the engine, or sair can route the default adb port.
